name: PT Surya Biru Murni Acetylene Tbk
summary: PT Surya Biru Murni Acetylene Tbk is an Indonesian enterprise specializing in the manufacturing of industrial gases. The company's comprehensive product line features essential gases like acetylene, oxygen, and nitrogen, alongside argon, carbon dioxide, helium, and various custom gas mixtures. Furthermore, it provides compressed air and specialized gases tailored for laboratory and analytical testing applications. This firm was established in 1980, maintains its headquarters in Balikpapan, Indonesia, and functions as a subsidiary of PT Surya Biru Titilea Investama.
